detail.title: Epistemic Disagreement Research: Source Collection
detail.summary: Initiating substantive source collection for the project on formal models of epistemic disagreement, focusing on Bayesian frameworks for weighing individual vs. group consensus.

children.title: Bayesian epistemology conditions for relying on individual evidence vs group consensus in multi-agent systems

detail.reason: The project requires peer-reviewed scholarly literature to establish formal bases for epistemic disagreement. This search targets specific conditions under which agents prioritize individual evidence or social consensus in Bayesian belief updating.
